name: person-zagorka

slots.subject: A game character: Zagorka, a lively fair-skinned Croatian woman newspaper reporter in her thirties, standing mid-step with a small notepad in one hand and a pencil raised in the other, a folded blank newspaper under her arm. A fitted dark plum jacket over a high-collared white blouse, a long grey skirt, a small brimmed hat with a feather, dark hair pinned up, buttoned ankle boots. A simple picture-book face with small dark dot eyes and a curious, eager look. Slightly stylised proportions, the head about one sixth of the height; not chibi.
slots.camera: Full-body three-quarter view at eye level, with little perspective.
slots.composition: The figure is centred and fills about nine tenths of the picture's height, with a clear margin on every side.
slots.background: Isolated on plain flat cream paper with no ground, no scenery and no shadow.

notes: Town townsperson: Zagorka, the newspaper reporter, asks for the steam lift.
